description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 2940015608766 FILTER ELEMENT,INTA: Line 0001 Qty 32 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0041 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). Quotes must be submitted electronically.
